effects.effect: Your expertise in history and lore allows you and your allies to outthink rivals in the present day. You and any ally within 10 squares of you gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason) [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test).
